page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is a bare-metal instance type built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 128 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core configuration, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading overhead. The system is equipped with 768 GB of system memory, providing 6 GB of RAM per core, and operates under the KVM hypervisor.

This instance integrates hardware acceleration via four NVIDIA A10 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached storage options.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers high resource density by combining a high count of dedicated physical cores with multi-GPU acceleration on a single bare-metal node. This hardware profile is designed for parallel computing workloads, including machine learning inference, deep learning training, graphics rendering, and high-performance computing tasks that require direct hardware access and high network throughput.
